visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a stone Shisa statue guarding Kokusai-dori street in Okinawa. A red bus and pedestrians pass by in the background under clear daylight. (2) The scene cuts to the interior of a vibrant souvenir shop, 'Bunkaya Zakkaten,' featuring a large shark decoration with a cartoon bird in its mouth, various t-shirts, and shelves packed with colorful merchandise. (3) Transitions to 'SPLASH,' a clothing store with a white aesthetic, displaying resort-style shirts and accessories in a bright, well-lit environment. (4) Close-ups follow of detailed ceramic plates with whale shark motifs and floral-patterned clothing on mannequins. (5) Shisa figurines of various sizes and colors are displayed on a wooden shelf in a gift shop. (6) The video moves to a ramen shop exterior with a traditional white curtain, followed by a close-up of 'Ryūka' ramen with black garlic oil and a piece of nori featuring a cartoon face. (7) A bowl of yellow mango shaved ice is shown, followed by the exterior of a 'Blue Seal' ice cream shop under bright sunlight. (8) Night falls at the 'Okinawa-Naha Yataimura' food stall village, showing a bustling atmosphere with people seated at outdoor tables under rows of red, white, and blue Orion Beer lanterns. (9) A daytime shot of a busy street with white cars and palm trees leads to a final graphic outro screen with social media handles.

(4) [Variety]: 如果想買文青系海島風情商品 可以到SPLASH逛逛. (5) [Variety]: 裡面很多可愛小物. (6) [Variety]: 也有賣整套的親子裝!. (7) [Variety]: 沖繩守護神 風獅. 也是個不錯的伴手禮選擇. (8) [Variety]: 逛累了巷內有間 琉家拉麵. (9) [Variety]: 招牌是琉焦蒜豬骨拉麵. (10) [Variety]: 蒜味非常香! 喜歡蒜香湯頭的可以試試. (11) [Variety]: 大蒜+洋蔥拌炒的黑蒜油. (12) [Variety]: 海苔上Q版人像超可愛. (13) [Variety]: 餐後會附上芒果冰解膩 我覺得很不錯. (14) [Variety]: 飯後甜點可以來一支 BLUE SEAL的冰淇淋. (15) [Variety]: 晚上時段到屋台村 體驗日式屋台熱鬧的氛圍!. (16) [Variety]: 氛圍很好~東西也不錯吃喔!. (17) [Variety]: 趕快分享給要去沖繩玩的朋友. (18) [Variety]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結. [Logo]: japanuts.com. @japanuts.
